backend.deviceOwnership: Application requests adapter and GPUDevice, then supplies that exact device to WebGPURenderer; backend and device identity asserted after initialization

source.identity: city.json sourceHash, plus validation SHA-256 of served files
source.attributes: Uncompressed Float32 positions and split normals, Uint32 triangle indices; every authored source matrix retained and audited. 478 source vehicle instances are rendered at live simulation transforms instead of their authored fixed transforms.

batching.method: One BatchedMesh per semantic material, splitting water by exact plane height, with original per-prototype geometry and exact Float32 instance matrices
batching.culling: Three BatchedMesh perObjectFrustumCulled, evaluated separately for each beauty, reflection and shadow camera
batching.sourceMatrices: Float32 RGBA matrix textures retain every original matrix and semantic ID. Promoted vehicle entries have visibility=false in all source batches; exact geometry/materials are reused by dynamic InstancedMesh actors.

quality.depth: Logarithmic depth buffer for centimetre-scale terrain overlays across the 2.18km city

passes.ownership: Directional sun only; explicit prepass before reflections and beauty
passes.geometry: All exact visible source geometry except non-occluding water
passes.cache: Static source and sun; invalidated on switching overview/walking or moving walking shadow region by 32 metres

passes.ownership: One sun; cached static nearest depth copied into a second target, full-detail moving geometry depth-tested into it before standard PCF
passes.geometry: Exact source vehicle meshes and canonical animated character meshes; explicit dynamic layer1
passes.cache: Invalidated each simulation revision or light-camera refit; static source layer2 remains cached
passes.filter: Standard PCF sampled once from nearest-depth union; static cache is not sampled by beauty materials

passes.ownership: One explicit camera-correct capture per exact visible water height, completed before beauty encoding; original full scene contributors and HDR/native resolution retained
passes.geometry: Full static and dynamic scene including offscreen contributors; reflection recursion disabled
passes.cache: No camera-dependent reflection reuse across rendered frames

passes.ownership: Beauty pass starts after shadow and reflection command buffers have submitted; no nested scene captures

environment.method: Procedural sky gradient, RGBA Float32 512x256, PMREM

lighting.AO: Not implemented; contact is represented by directional shadows

effects.water: Static Fresnel blend of source water color and full-resolution planar scene reflection; opaque water, no volumetric transmission
effects.surfaces: Small static world-space TSL noise modulation on grass, paving, stone and asphalt; original material colors and geometry retained
effects.foliage: Source geometry and split normals; opaque, static, no wind
effects.atmosphere: Light distance fog beginning at3400 metres, beyond the top-down camera height, ending at9000 metres

time.renderPolicy: Continuous fixed-step city life, including stationary cameras; paused test states render on camera/viewport changes
time.hiddenDocument: No life advancement; no accumulated resume jump
time.matrixEvaluation: Evaluate final actor world matrices once before the complete frame; every shadow, reflection and beauty pass uses that identical pose

navigation.collision: Spatially indexed oriented source footprint rectangles; trees use trunk footprints; water polygons with island exclusions; explicit support surfaces for bridges/docks; all promoted source car footprints removed from the fixed collider index
navigation.regionalInspection: Lake and park aerial poses fit the current manifest water/path extents; walking spawns stay from the source manifest with collision-safe adjustment, and the lake spawn faces along the nearby promenade tangent
navigation.sourceComparisonCameras: Diagnostic captures use source camera poses and the Blender horizontal lens model: 36mm sensor, 26mm non-overview focal length. Normal walking stays48 degrees vertical.

validation: runtime_validation.json records actual results; render choices do not imply that tests passed
compatibilityGuard: Application-owned sun shadow and exact-height water reflection nodes submit sequential prepasses before the beauty encoder. Automatic nested effect callbacks are disabled; original Three shadow/reflection implementations are invoked explicitly. This prevents camera-specific BatchedMesh indirect-ID maps from being overwritten before the parent command buffer submits.

cityLife.traffic: Deterministic right-hand lane/turn graph, signals, following distance, and concurrent geometrically nonconflicting junction reservations. Every original source vehicle identity and prototype participates in traffic.
cityLife.pedestrianGeometry: Uncompressed canonical49-bone,5622-triangle character with default outfit; original Walk and Idle clips
cityLife.pedestrianCulling: Conservative2m local bounding sphere covering every original pose; full original mesh per pass
cityLife.grounding: Exact source support triangles and original clip offsets; safe route centers with validated passing lanes
cityLife.routes: 80 walkers; eight near each primary landmark, forty distributed across checked sidewalks and park paths
cityLife.materials: Six restrained runtime skin/shirt/pants palettes; source asset unchanged
cityLife.vehicleGeometry: Exact original meshes and source materials, full detail in beauty, reflection, and dynamic shadow passes; no fixed duplicate or ghost collider.
